Add the Thanksgiving offers to your list before shopping.
Existing users: refer a friend so they sign up and submit a receipt — this unlocks your 100% turkey offer; check the app each Monday for side-dish offers.
Buy the qualifying items at Walmart (or another participating store).

timing: November seasonal program; cash back credited after receipt submission (Ibotta standard: within 24 hours).
who_pays: Ibotta pays you — it's 100% cash back on your Thanksgiving groceries. Ibotta cash back withdraws to your bank or PayPal as real cash, not store credit.
who_qualifies: US Ibotta users. New users get the full feast basket at 100% back; existing users unlock the 100% turkey offer by referring a friend and get 100%-back side-dish offers each Monday in November.
work_available: It runs in November only. The latest officially documented edition is Thanksgiving 2025 (the program's sixth consecutive year); as of September 2026 the 2026 edition has not been published yet, so check the app when the season opens. Offers are limited quantity and valid while supplies last.
what_gets_accepted: You must buy the exact qualifying items (turkey up to $15 plus sides, per published offer lists) at a participating store — Walmart is the featured partner. Each item is one redemption per user, and you submit your receipt in the app; offers run while supplies last.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee to join. But you buy the groceries first with your own money — the 100% cash back lands after you submit the receipt, so you front the full basket cost temporarily. This is free Thanksgiving groceries, not extra income — budget 15–30 minutes in November to add the offers, shop, and submit the receipt.
when_cash_arrives: Cash back lands after receipt submission — Ibotta's standard timing is within 24 hours — and withdraws to your bank or PayPal as real cash.
